integrity: The proof gives exact finite overlap identities; the standalone exact-rational and symbolic verifier is reproducible, but not an independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The sign comparison is for induced three-vertex open paths and triangles in standard fixed-edge and independent-edge random graph models; no stochastic negative-association claim is made. Historical priority relative to broad classical graph-statistic identities is a residual risk.
title: An exact negative triangle–open-wedge covariance under fixed-edge sampling
